$comment: Committed expected failure counts for the Slice-0 thesis invariants.
These numbers are MEASURED, never predicted. Each check exits 0 iff its finding
count equals the number here — a count that DROPS is red too, which forces the
decrement into the same PR as the fix and makes a silent regression impossible
in either direction. A baseline decremented without an accompanying source
change is visible in review as a one-line diff with no fix beside it.
Every entry is currently NON-ZERO on purpose. An invariant that passes on day
one is measuring nothing. When a `blockedBy` slice lands, that slice decrements
its own baseline; when a baseline reaches 0 the `--expect` gate is removed and
the check switches to zero-tolerance (spec Phase 4).
Measured 2026-07-19 on ci/thesis-invariants against a freshly built compiler

(DA-d) 'Statically prerendered content retrievable without JS — ❌ — packages/app/src/prerender.ts:283 and :382 — renderToString(...) with no options, so every SSG page ships non-hydratable output' (one finding: one defect, the missing options object in the SSG writer).
dual-audience.expectChangedReason: FOUNDER SCOPE DECISION (2026-07-19) — not a regression, and not a newly introduced defect. Prerender was ruled IN SCOPE for the dual-audience property, so check:dual-audience gained the DA-d probe and now measures 4 where it measured 3. NOTHING WAS FIXED by this change and nothing broke: packages/app/src/prerender.ts:283/:382 have always called renderToString(...) with no options — the check simply did not look at the SSG path, so a shipping defect went unmeasured. Verified after the change: check:dual-audience reports 4 findings and still FAILS, as it must. DA-d is a SEPARATE finding from DA-c rather than a widening of it, because they are separate defects in separate files with separate fixes — DA3 repairing packages/router/src/server.ts does not repair the SSG writer, and grouping them would let one fix silently decrement a baseline covering two live defects.
dual-audience.ratchet: DA1 (MarkdownResolver) takes 4→3; DA2 (UA negotiation) takes 3→2; DA3 (after CO5, path keys must agree first) takes 2→1; DA3b (hydratable options in the SSG writer, packages/app/src/prerender.ts) takes 1→0. DA3 and DA3b are tracked separately on purpose: the router fix and the prerender fix are independent edits.
